_about: The four review-code LABELS a CRS prints, by the role each plays in the recommendation policy (comparison._recommend_code). The POLICY is fixed in code; only the words are the client's. Defaults are the labels the system has always used. A client that codes A/B/C/D or 1/2/3/4 edits the four values below, e.g. "approved": "Code A - Approved", "approved_with_comments": "Code B - Approved with Comments", "revise_and_resubmit": "Code C - Revise and Resubmit", "manual_review": "Code D - Engineer to review". Each value must be non-empty and the four must differ. A run keeps the label it was given; changing this file relabels future recommendations and the engineer's choice list, not stored decisions.
